examples.title: Result row
examples.description: Search result with type, source, snippet and action.
examples.behavior: Use for compact result lists where source and snippet support quick selection.
examples.qa: Highlighted match is readable and not the only relevance cue.

examples.title: Selected result
examples.description: Current result in a keyboard-navigated list.
examples.behavior: Selected state should connect to preview/detail area.

examples.title: No result
examples.description: Search query returns no matching document.
examples.behavior: Explain next step rather than rendering a fake row as data.
examples.qa: Empty row cannot be mistaken for a real result.

examples.title: Search error
examples.description: Search source or index is unavailable.
examples.behavior: Show failure context and keep retry/open action nearby.
examples.qa: Error copy is specific enough for support.

default.qa: Title, source and snippet are readable.

hover.qa: Hover does not alter row height.
